integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Cinematic, realistic commercial automotive-grade style, high-quality CG rendering with physical lighting, wet-surface reflections and visible film grain. A single continuous 10-second shot from start to end — no cuts, no push-in, no added camera moves.

CAMERA (hard constraint): The camera begins in a close-up on the front of the car — tight on the sweeping hood curve and the driver-side headlight, framed low, hugging the wet asphalt. From 0 to 2s it holds this close framing. Starting at 2s it performs one continuous, smooth pull-back (dolly out) along the side of the car, widening the frame until, by about 7s, the entire car is fully visible. From 7 to 10s it holds a full-body wide shot: the whole supercar sits centered in frame in a 3/4 front-side view, camera at wheel-hub height, low to the ground. The camera travels forward in the same direction as the car the whole time (a forward-tracking pull-back), never passing ahead of it, never circling, never rising into a high angle, pitch staying low and level throughout. Strictly prohibited: push-in, orbit, tilt up or down, any cut.

BLOCKING (hard constraint): The supercar drives fast and steadily along the elevated highway, straight in its lane, constant high speed, never braking, never swerving. In the close-up phase the car's front dominates the frame; as the camera pulls back the full silhouette is revealed — low wide stance, elongated hood, short tail, sleek fastback roofline. The car holds roughly the same screen position throughout the pull-back because the camera retreats at matching speed, so the body stays centered while the environment streams past.

SHOT CONTENT: A Mercedes-style luxury supercar coupe — low-slung and wide, long power-dome hood, muscular front fenders, sloped fastback rear, aggressive quad exhaust, large performance alloy wheels — races down a curving elevated city highway at night. Rain falls steadily; the asphalt is wet and glistening, mirroring the orange sodium street lamps and the passing skyline. The night is visibly lit but not dark: warm orange pools of street light plus a cool blue-teal ambient fill keep the whole scene bright and readable. Rain streaks bead and trail across the glossy dark paint, catching each lamp in thin highlights. The elevated highway sweeps in a wide curve with guardrails and lampposts streaming past, motion-blurred; distant city towers glow with lit windows; a few blurred headlight trails of other cars pass in the opposite lane. A light mist hugs the roadway, catching the lamp light. The low camera emphasizes speed — the car's body is pin-sharp while everything around it carries speed blur. Visible film grain, subtle lens flare from the lamps, realistic reflections on wet metal and glass.

overall_soundscape:
The deep, throaty roar of the supercar's engine rising as it accelerates; wet tires hissing over rain-soaked asphalt; rain pattering on metal; the whoosh of air; distant city hum and the Doppler whine of passing traffic.

non_diegetic_music:
A sleek, high-energy cinematic score — a driving electronic pulse with a low sub-bass thrum, strings rising as the camera pulls back to reveal the full car, then settling into a wide, clean sustained note holding the full-body shot.
